forest-stage.$description: Forest Stage — Hero section background, dark feature spotlights — deep green anchors the dramatic first impression

lime-sprout.$description: Lime Sprout — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

ember-coral.$description: Ember Coral — Decorative stroke accent — wavy underlines, hand-drawn doodles, product frame borders, section dividers

coral-whisper.$description: Coral Whisper — Soft warm surface wash, hero gradient highlight, gentle background tints behind editorial sections

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Primary content surface, page background for feature/pricing/footer sections — the default canvas

true-black.$description: True Black — Headlines, primary body text, dark icons, logo mark on light surfaces

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Dark surface (footer dark mode, inverse cards), button text on light fills, heading accent

stone.$description: Stone — Body paragraph text on cream surfaces, secondary headings, footer description copy

slate.$description: Slate — Strong secondary text, nav links on cream, meta labels

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, subtle borders on cream, disabled states, tag outlines

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline dividers, form field borders, table separators — the structural neutral

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surface lift on cream, button text on dark fills, input field backgrounds

moss.$description: Moss — Logo green, icon strokes, secondary brand accent — the mid-green companion to the forest stage

gt-alpina-condensed.$description: Display headlines — the editorial voice. Used at hero scale (96-136px) for the dramatic serif moments that anchor each section. Condensed cuts and tight line-heights give it poster-like authority. Substitute: 'Playfair Display' or 'Bodoni Moda' condensed at matching weight

gt-america-standard.$description: Body text, subheadings, medium-weight headings. The workhorse grotesk for long-form paragraphs and section sub-headlines. Slight -0.007em tightening gives it a composed, not loose, feel. Substitute: 'Inter' or 'Söhne'

gt-america-extended.$description: UI chrome: button labels, navigation links, footer column headers, small labels. Wider proportions at small sizes improve readability in compact UI. Substitute: 'Inter' at letter-spacing 0.02em

gt-america-condensed.$description: Section eyebrows and secondary display — the 'SCHEDULING EXPERIENCE' style small-caps labels with wide tracking (+0.05em at 18px), and tighter condensed headlines at 38px (-0.025em). Substitute: 'Inter' condensed variant or 'Barlow Condensed'

intervariable.$description: Fallback/utility text — appears in footer fine print and secondary system text. The site is GT-America-first; Inter fills the generic-system gaps
